steps.title: Client intake
steps.agent: Capture brief, industry, goals, budget band.

steps.title: Requirements analysis
steps.agent: Turn brief into a scoped feature list + sitemap.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.agent: Draft a proposal with scope, timeline, and deliverables.

steps.title: Pricing
steps.agent: Compute price from scope, pages, and integrations.

steps.title: Contract
steps.agent: Generate contract + milestones from the accepted proposal.

steps.title: Project setup
steps.agent: Create the project, repo, and staging environment.

steps.title: Task breakdown
steps.agent: Split into design, front-end, back-end, and QA tasks.

steps.title: Execution tracking
steps.agent: Monitor progress and flag blocked or overdue tasks.

steps.title: Quality assurance
steps.agent: Run the QA checklist: responsive, a11y, performance.
